## MCP - Metadata Extractor

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/metadata-extractor

**Parameters:**
- `data` (required): URL or HTML content
- `source` (optional): url | html (default: url)
- `options.include_json_ld` (optional): boolean (default: true)
- `options.include_twitter` (optional): boolean (default: true)
- `options.include_opengraph` (optional): boolean (default: true)
- `options.include_standard` (optional): boolean (default: true)
- `options.fetch_favicon` (optional): boolean (default: true)
- `execution_mode` (optional): online | offline

**Returns:** Normalized metadata with OG, Twitter, JSON-LD, standard meta tags

**Priority:** OpenGraph > Twitter Cards > JSON-LD > Standard Meta
